title: jev-trader v3 dashboard: choose the visual world
question: New Next.js dashboard for v3 (read-only: paper trader, catalyst recorder, lab verdicts, Jev probes). The roll assigned Field Trial. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Field Trial
options.lineage: Agricultural experiment-station plot plans, where modern statistics was worked out
options.thesis: Every test is a plot in a field: families are strips, gate checks are plots, and an untested plot stays fallow.
options.viewport: Green side rail (Trader, Catalysts, Lab, Jev probes, engine heartbeat). Main: the trend candidate's paper run as a strip of day plots between kill and graduate, the gate plot plan (4 families by 12 checks), and the latest scored headlines at right.
options.risk: A grid of tinted plots can read as a generic heatmap unless the fallow and sealed states are drawn with care.

raised.raise: Live values change in place inside fixed columns; nothing reflows when a quote or status updates.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: rejected families stay on the plan, marked at the check that stopped them.
Colour is only ever a result: pass, pending, fail, sealed. The shell stays green and limewash.

options.label: Sequential Chart
options.lineage: Wartime quality-control sequential test charts on graph paper
options.thesis: Everything running is a path between two lines drawn in advance: kill below, graduate above.
options.viewport: Top bar navigation. A wide sequential chart leads: the paper run's path between the kill and graduate boundaries with the card's expected decision day marked. Below it, the four families' verdict table and the catalyst markout table.
options.risk: The most literal reading of the product, and the closest to a standard analytics dashboard: a chart on top, tables under it.

options.label: Gate Line Map
options.thesis: Each strategy family is a coloured line through the gate's stations, ending at the check that rejected it.
options.viewport: Midnight shell with a side rail. The line map leads: four family lines run left to right through twelve gate stations and stop where they failed; the lockbox is a closed terminus. Paper run and headlines sit in panels beneath.
options.case: Wins on product clarity for the gate (where each family stopped is read off the map); loses on audience identification and on the live trader, which is not a route.
options.risk: Twelve stations by four lines crowds quickly, and a dark screen all day sits badly beside daylight work.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Every coin a row whose status flips in place.
options.viewport: A flap board of coins and statuses.
options.case: This is the look being replaced, and v3 has one candidate and no departures to announce.
options.kept: Values change in place inside fixed columns.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Strategy families as a ranked cast.
options.case: Cute ranking undermines a page whose job is to say that nothing passed.
options.kept: Every family gets the same fixed set of facts in the same places.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: One idea per soft card, one colour for actions.
options.viewport: A single column of cards with a bottom bar.
options.case: A phone-first card stack wastes a desktop monitor and a read-only page has almost nothing to press.
options.kept: Labels written the way a person would say them.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder and Plate
options.thesis: Black text columns with colour quarantined in plates.
options.viewport: A page of entries with a shoulder margin.
options.case: It reads as a document, and this is a screen that is glanced at while it changes.
options.kept: Colour appears only where it carries a result.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each pipeline step a coupon that is stamped, never removed.
options.viewport: A coupon book of pipeline legs.
options.case: One journey per sheet cannot hold four families and twenty coins at once.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark shadcn trading dashboard: stat cards, an equity chart, a positions table.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, four stat cards, an area chart, and a table of strategies.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other bot dashboard, and it puts P&L first when the honest headline is that nothing passed.
